## Problem link

Paste a direct link to the problem.

## Problem platform

LeetCode, Codewars, HackerRank, CheckiO, GeeksforGeeks, or another platform.

## Preferred language

Which language would you like to see? You can also say "any language".

## Would you like a test file too?

A test file in `tests/<language>/test_practice<n>.<ext>` is optional but encouraged. Leave a note if you want one included.

## Additional context

Share the problem name or any details that would help identify the requested solution.
